full_judgment: 17. Finally, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioners submits by citing decisions held in the cases of the Cricket Association of Bengal and others vs. State of West Bengal and others, reported in 1971 Supreme Court Cases (Cri) 446 and Pranab Kumar Mitra vs. State of West Bengal and another reported in AIR 1959 Supreme Court 144 that when the High Court thinks it fit and proper it may take action suo motu against the order passed by any subordinate Court. But we do not think that this is an appropriate case where this Court should pass an order suo motu interfering on the ground of illegality of the impugned order or for ends of justice.
